property_summary: For any two values v1 and v2, calling SetMinSum(v1) then SetMinSum(v2) before Initialized() leaves MinSum equal to v2 in the reference contract, but the buggy version keeps the lock set so the second call reverts and MinSum stays at v1.
change_summary: Replace `locked_ = false;` at the end of the modifier with `locked_ = true;` so the lock is never released and a second SetMinSum call reverts, leaving MinSum at its first value.
